_notes: Realigned 2026-09-04 to match db/protocols/rfc2305-duty-reservation.json and docs/lore/os-lineages.md sections 5-6's real worked example -- previously used placeholder EXPP flavor text (expp.conf/expp.state/expp.rfc.txt). dev/<hostname>/ is no longer hand-authored here -- Console.gd synthesizes it at load time from db/hardware/ + the instance's own hardware.installed_components (ContentLoader.synthesize_dev_folder), so device files can't drift out of sync with the actual hardware/component data. Only covers slots db/hardware/ actually defines (power, buffer) -- no laser/transceiver slot modeled yet, so laser.tx/laser.rx aren't synthesized; that's a real hardware-schema gap, not papered over here.
